Note: This dataset comprises the complete set of putative BA analogues, including their molecular formulas, generated via MetLLM. In addition, BA_analogues_set.txt contains the raw candidate BA structures generated using three complementary approaches, primarily to enable assessment of the distribution of structures from different data sources. The structures from these sources were processed using a MetSpace-like workflow, including cleaning, validation, and deduplication, and their molecular formulas were computed. This dataset therefore allows researchers not only to use the 3,900 prioritized candidate novel BAs from MetSpace, but also to perform molecular-formula matching against a larger and more structurally diverse collection of putative BA analogues. Future updates and extensions will also consider annotation based on this dataset.
